list.name: row_house
list.kind: a town house on a city street
list.request: Write `types/row_house.py`: `build(b, part, seed, **params)` builds an ordinary **town house on a city street** -- the dwelling of a family with no yard and no shop, the building a dense street is mostly made of. It is **narrow to the street and deep into the plot**: a front room on the lane, a passage or a stair beside it, and rooms running back behind. Its two long flanks are **party walls** -- flat, unbroken, with no eave and no opening on them -- because in a street of these the next house stands against them; the roof runs front to back so its gable ends face the flanks. Where the plot allows a storey above, a stair inside reaches it and **every room above is walkable from the front door on foot** -- a room you can only get to by jumping is a room nobody uses. There is no courtyard: this is the house for the ground a courtyard house does not fit on. Declare `KIND = "plot"`, `FORM = "east_asian"` and `ROLE = "urban"`. `PARAMS` for `storeys` and one more of your own choosing. Different seeds have to give a different house -- a different depth, a different front, a different arrangement inside. Run `check.py` until every instance is clean.
